fields.description:
## Context / Problem

Discovered during the Step 7 parity census for bug `5931-78a3-95d2-44cd`. On Jira Data
Center the outbound comment send path applies **no length fit at all**, so an
over-length comment is handed to Jira unfitted. Bug `6afc-20ee-84e5-4dd5` established
that Jira exits 0 on an over-length comment rejection, so the comment never lands and is
re-emitted every pass — the outbound comment-sync loop. DC's ceiling is deployment-resolved
(`comment_max_chars()`, bug `049e`) and typically LOWER than an unfitted body, which makes
an unfitted DC body more likely to be rejected, not less.

## Evidence

- `adapters/jira_datacenter/_links.py` `_CommentsMixin.add_comment` passes `body`
  straight to `self._client.add_comment(remote_id, body)`; no fit, no sanitize.
- `adapters/jira_datacenter/backend.py` `JiraDataCenterBackend.add_comment` is a bare
  delegate to that transport.
- `_DCSanitizer.sanitize_comment` — the send-side sanitizer with its operator warning —
  has **no production caller**. `grep -rn "\.sanitize_comment(" src tests` returns test
  files ONLY. The same is true for Cloud's `_JiraSanitizer.sanitize_comment`.
- `fit_comment` (the differ-side twin) IS wired, via `outbound_comments._diff_comments`.
  So the comparison half of the convergence pair is live and the SEND half is not.
- Note this is NOT bug 5931's mechanism — with no truncation on the DC path there is
  nothing to cut the RECONCILER_MARKER off. It is the mirror-image gap found by the same
  census: Cloud truncates and used to lose the marker; DC does not truncate at all.

## Approach

- **Fit the DC send path, reusing the existing marker-preserving fitter — no second
  fitter is written.** Wire `_DCSanitizer.sanitize_comment` into
  `JiraDataCenterBackend.add_comment` (the one production caller of the transport's
  `add_comment`, covering all three enactment sites in `dispatch_one.py` /
  `dispatch_apply_phases.py`), and recompose `sanitize_comment` so its injected
  `truncate` is `outbound_comments.fit_preserving_marker` over the existing
  `_truncate_dc_comment_body` at the deployment-resolved `comment_max_chars()` ceiling —
  exactly the composition Cloud's send path uses in `acli_cli_ops.add_comment` (commit
  6724e79e8f). An undecorated (marker-less) body is handed straight to the raw fit by
  `fit_preserving_marker`, so every existing `sanitize_comment` behaviour on undecorated
  bodies stays byte-identical (the 049e ceiling tests keep passing unchanged). The
  operator truncation warning in the shared `jira_family.sanitize_comment` fires once,
  as today. Ceiling resolution itself (`comment_max_chars()` / `resolve_comment_max_chars`)
  is untouched.
- **Keep the dedup key synchronized with what lands (the class commit 103729e90c fixed
  for Cloud).** Fitting DC sends through `fit_preserving_marker` changes the landed body
  for over-length comments, so `_DCSanitizer.fit_comment` (the `_diff_comments`
  comparison key) is re-derived via `outbound_comments.fit_comment_as_sent` over the
  same raw fit — the marker-stripped body the fitted send actually lands — mirroring
  Cloud's post-e339 `_JiraSanitizer.fit_comment`. Both sides change in this ONE change,
  never independently. In-limit bodies return byte-identical from `fit_comment_as_sent`,
  so already-mirrored comments keep matching.
- **Cloud's dead `sanitize_comment` is REMOVED, not wired.** Cloud's live send fit is
  `fit_preserving_marker(body, AdfCodec.fit_outbound)` inside `acli_cli_ops.add_comment`
  (measures SERIALIZED ADF); the dead `_JiraSanitizer.sanitize_comment` applies a plain
  32,767-char cap that would cut the RECONCILER_MARKER if ever wired — the false
  assurance the AC names. Wiring it in front of the codec fit would double-truncate under
  a different rule, so removal is the correct resolution. Remove
  `_JiraSanitizer.sanitize_comment`, its delegate `jira_fields._sanitize_comment`, the
  `acli.py` facade re-export, and the `FieldSanitizer.sanitize_comment` protocol member
  (nothing calls it through the port; DC keeps its concrete, now-wired method — a
  Protocol permits extra members on an implementation).

## Scope

- `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/adapters/jira_datacenter/backend.py` — recompose
  `sanitize_comment` (marker-preserving), re-derive `fit_comment` (as-sent), wire
  `JiraDataCenterBackend.add_comment` through `sanitize_comment`.
- `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/adapters/jira/backend.py` — remove dead
  `_JiraSanitizer.sanitize_comment`.
- `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/adapters/jira/jira_fields.py` — remove dead
  `_sanitize_comment` (and its now-unused imports).
- `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/adapters/jira/acli.py` — drop the
  `_sanitize_comment` facade re-export.
- `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/_backend.py` — drop the
  `FieldSanitizer.sanitize_comment` protocol member; fix `fit_comment`'s docstring
  cross-reference.
- `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/outbound_comments.py` — `fit_comment_as_sent`
  docstring: no longer Cloud-only.
- Tests: NEW `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_dc_send_path_comment_fit.py` (RED test
  through the real DC transport with a stubbed jira client); update
  `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_dc_comment_ceiling_049e.py`'s
  `test_fit_comment_converges_with_sanitize_comment` to the as-sent contract; remove the
  four Cloud `sanitize_comment` characterization tests in
  `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_backend_characterization.py`; drop the fake's unused
  `sanitize_comment` in `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/backend_support.py` if nothing else
  consumes it (default: keep it when any other test does).

## Testing

- **RED (wiring):** build `JiraDataCenterBackend` over the REAL transport
  (`_links.py` mixins) with a stubbed jira client that records the body it receives;
  send an over-ceiling RECONCILER_MARKER-decorated body through
  `backend.add_comment`. Assert the wire body is `<= comment_max_chars()` AND still ends
  with the marker's decoration. Fails on current code (body passes through unfitted);
  passes post-fix.
- **RED (dedup-key consistency):** for the same over-length body,
  `sanitizer.fit_comment(user_body)` must equal the marker-stripped wire body captured
  from the send path — the e339 desync class, asserted on DC.
- **Edges:** an in-limit decorated body passes through byte-identical; a `0` (unlimited)
  ceiling passes an over-stock-length body through untouched.
- Existing suites stay green: `test_dc_comment_ceiling_049e.py` (undecorated bodies hit
  the identical raw fit), `test_dc_outbound_comment_length_convergence.py`,
  `test_dc_backend_characterization.py`, `diffing/test_comment_dedup_key_matches_send_fit.py`,
  `mutate/test_outbound_comment_marker_survives_truncation.py`.
- Verify: `pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_dc_send_path_comment_fit.py
  tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_dc_comment_ceiling_049e.py
  tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_dc_backend_characterization.py
  tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_backend_characterization.py
  tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/mutate/ tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing/ -q`, then
  `make lint`, `make typecheck`, `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The DC outbound comment send path fits the body through the deployment-resolved
      ceiling before handing it to the transport — checked by the new send-path test
      asserting the transport-client-captured wire body is `<= comment_max_chars()`.
- [ ] The RECONCILER_MARKER survives the DC fit (reuses `fit_preserving_marker`; no new
      fitter) — checked by the same test asserting the captured wire body still ends
      with the marker.
- [ ] A test drives the DC send path with an over-length body and asserts the wire value
      is within `comment_max_chars()` (RED on current code) — checked by running the new
      test on pre-fix code (fails) and post-fix (passes).
- [ ] `_DCSanitizer.fit_comment` equals the marker-stripped body the fitted send path
      lands (dedup-key consistency, the e339 class) — checked by the new consistency
      test and the updated 049e convergence test.
- [ ] Cloud's `sanitize_comment` is either wired or removed — RESOLVED AS REMOVED
      (rationale in Approach); checked by `grep -rn "sanitize_comment" src/rebar` showing
      only the DC (wired) implementation and the shared `jira_family` helper it uses.
- [ ] `make lint`, `make typecheck`, targeted pytest, and the complexity ratchet all
      pass — checked by running them in the worktree.
